resources.string: Enforces the daily app limits you set in TimeWise and shows a small floating timer while a focus challenge runs. When an app\'s time is up, TimeWise closes it and shows your extra-time steps. It only sees which app is open, never what\'s on the screen or what you type.
Today\'s screen time in a ring that fills as the day goes on.
Today\'s screen time, your level and how it compares with yesterday.
Today\'s screen time, level, unlocks and your most used apps.
